source: Timetable: GAPEKA 2026, KP DJKA 116 Tahun 2026 (Jawa) and KP DJKA 119 Tahun 2026 (Sumatera Bagian Selatan), Direktorat Jenderal Perkeretaapian, valid from 2026-12-01, via the repo GTFS feeds supabase/data/gtfs-gapeka-2026-*. Runs carry the printed times; est=true marks a stop where GAPEKA prints no time (interpolated on track km). GAPEKA also lists operational stops (crossings, crew change) without saying which serve passengers. Tracks: OpenStreetMap paths from v1; services with "track":"straight" use straight lines x1.2 (approximate). Services with "until" are the v1 estimates (Wikipedia list, Gapeka 2023-2025), shown only up to that date.
